Premise: does not hold as written. Not claimed. For `epic:#26676#1`.

The `domain:ui` seats read this card for dispatch 2026-10-30T03:00Z. Its Target predates the v4 cards now in flight and contradicts two of them:

1. **Target 2** asks for "sticky tabs 详情 / 时间线 / 关联 (the tabbed tier)" on the phone. #27524 item 6 (the maintainer's v4 ruling) retires the tabbed tier: below 760 px the record is one column, and "the embedded record and the phone use the same rule". The tab row (item 8) and the top bar (item 7) are on every face, phone included, and 时间线 becomes 动态, a panel.
2. **Target 1** asks for "the view tabs become a horizontally scrolling chip row". #27594 retires the view tab row in favour of the title dropdown, the narrow list included.

The v4 board folder carries its own `RecordMobile.dc.html` (at `a7825499aa`), so the Target should be rewritten against canvas 60 before anyone builds it. #27524, #27545 and #27594 are claimed by `domain:ui` seat 2 and touch the same header and tab components, so this card also runs after they land.

Asked: a Target rewrite by the epic PM against the v4 board. The card stays in `pm:queue`; the seats will not claim it until it is rewritten. #27059 (skills/docs for the record page) likewise waits for v4 to land, since it documents what v4 ships.

**Target rewritten against canvas 60** · 2026-10-31 · `pm:queue` kept, no label or assignee change.

The maintainer, 2026-10-31, verbatim: 「按画布 60 的 RecordMobile 板重写 #27058 的 Target，保持 pm:queue」 — answering `domain:ui` seat 3's reading of 2026-10-30 (comment 6512993303) that the old Target 1 (a view-tab chip row) and Target 2 (sticky 详情 / 时间线 / 关联 tabs, the tabbed tier) contradicted #27594 and #27524 item 6.

What changed in the body above:

- **Source** re-measured on `origin/main` `a0f865491d`: the phone list is already card rows + an `AppHeader` 「<view> ▾」 dropdown + the FAB; the record opens in the pane's full-screen drawer face, not as a page, because the console calls `deriveRecordSurface` without `viewport: 'mobile'` and the spec's phone → page rule never fires; the body is still the tabbed tier until #27524 ② merges.
- **Target** is now the v4 record in a < 760 px container (#27524 items 6–12 and #27594 unchanged) plus what only a phone adds: the record is always a page (the console passes the spec's own `viewport: 'mobile'`), the #27594 title switcher replaces the `MobileViewSwitcherContext` dropdown, the top bar compresses to 「‹ <object>」 + counter / ↓ ↑, highlights in two columns (max 4), the business actions in a bottom bar (1 + 1 + ⋯), the enlarged tab draws the child object's card rows, and a related record is pushed as a page with the path row (the board's own note is quoted). The board's chip row and its 「‹ Mira Costa ↑ ↓ ⋯」 line are read through n47 / n50, as the body says.
- **Ordering**: runs after #27524 ③ (tab row) and ④ (top bar) are on `main`; the seats should not claim it before. Not `pm:blocked` — the maintainer's word is `pm:queue`.
- **File surface / Acceptance** point at today's files (`objectViewPageHeader.tsx`, `AppHeader.tsx`, `MobileViewSwitcherContext.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, the shared stack tier and the ③ tab-row component), screenshots on `examples/app-crm` at 390 × 844.
- The Rulings section and the filing footer are kept verbatim; a second footer line records this rewrite.

Two readings in the new Target are the seat's, not the maintainer's, and the maintainer may veto either: the phone top bar's left end as one link 「‹ <object>」 (the record name is the title below), and the bottom bar's cap of one secondary action at 390 px.
